notes: Control, strict test: public. The state created the corporation by statute and transferred national property free of charge; there is no private founder or owner. The state does not directly name a board majority, but it appoints the head and approves every non-ex-officio director, and no private body has any appointment right. notes: CONTROL (classification-critical) private_nonprofit AGREED under D041, with a flagged boundary. Ownership prong: the university is owned and maintained by the foundation (KEKVA Act 22. § (1)), a private-law foundation ('magánjogi szereplőként', preamble) that Nftv 4. § classes as a private HEI. The State was the founder (Act XXIII/2021 1. § (2): the minister acted for the State) but had to assign all founder's rights to the board (1. § (4)), irrevocably (KEKVA 7. § (1)). D041's ownership prong requires a public-law body or public institution; a Civil-Code foundation is neither. The State keeps only a residual claim on the assets if the foundation is wound up without successor (KEKVA 14. § (3)), which is not ownership. Appointment prong: in 2023/24 vacancies were filled by the board with the supervisory board (KEKVA 7. § (4)); Szeged365 (14 Apr 2023) reports that the foundation itself elected the replacement for the resigning minister Lantos Csaba. Caveat for a sensitivity: most members sitting in 2023/24 were named by the State as founder in 2021, and 7. § (5) allows a founding deed to give outside bodies nomination rights (Szeged's deed not read). Band: 1,465,000/7,841,616 = 18.7% moderate; min 230,000 = 2.9% (low), max 2,700,000 = 34.4% (high), so band_unstable yes. felvi max (fogorvos 1,350,000/sem) and min (germanisztika [német nemzetiségi] 115,000/sem) re-opened.
